metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by emaarco — protection, observability, automation, and more.

plugins.name: agento-patronum
plugins.description: Blocks Claude Code's access to sensitive files, credentials, and commands (.env, SSH keys, AWS/kube configs, printenv) via a PreToolUse hook.

plugins.name: protego-totalum
plugins.description: One-command best practice: /protego-init turns on Claude Code's native OS sandbox globally (network default-deny, writes confined to the worktree) via ~/.claude/settings.json. Setup only, no runtime hooks.

plugins.name: revelio
plugins.description: Reveals failed tool calls, API errors, and permission denials via per-repo JSONL log.

plugins.name: felix-felicis
plugins.description: Everyday automation skills — submit repos to awesome lists, draft meeting invitations, and more.
